newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela says will sell Alucasa in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela says will sell Alucasa in early 1997.

text.p: Venezuela's state Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade will sell small aluminum company Alucasa at the beginning of 1997 after two earlier attempts failed, Fogade President Esther de Margulis said.
"We expect to sell the company at the beginning of the coming year," Margulis told reporters without giving further details.

A slated November sale of the 20,000 tonne per year smelter was canceled after no bidders signed up to take part in the auction. Likewise an August sale was called-off at the last minute to give investors more time to assess the company.
A base price of $45 million set for the first auction was dropped to $40 million for the second.

Alucasa is 49 percent owned by state privatization body the Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) and 51 percent owned by a consortium of 16 private investors and banks, some of which were taken over by Fogade during the 1994-5 banking crisis.
